bundle.longDescription: MnemoScript is a local-first writing studio for novelists and worldbuilders: a rich-text editor with a smooth caret, slash blocks, read-aloud and offline dictation; mind maps; a fantasy map studio; and a PDF book compiler. Projects are plain folders on your disk.
